purpose: M15S4 native post-drop actor/list and reference/dropper mutation contracts
calling_convention: cdecl(actor_pointer, reference_pointer); callee preserves ESI/EDI and leaves arguments on caller stack
executed: 0x004DB4A0 with 0x0046B680 returning null, selecting raw reference +8 bit 0x400
boundaries: Actor argument is null, equal to Player singleton at 0x00B333C4, or a different nonnull pointer. The helper does not validate NPC base type.
Reference virtual +0x78 is an opaque input predicate, separately configured for its pre/post calls. No base-form/on-disk flag mapping is established.
Reference virtual +0x40 records the 0x20000 change request; this is not a literal persistent flag.
0x0046B680 returns null; other 0x004DB4A0 nonnull-lookup/TLS branches do not execute.
0x0041E210 extra lookup returns configured existing records or null.
0x00401F00 allocator returns fresh zeroed memory. Allocation failure is excluded.
0x0041E0A0 generic ExtraDataList add is a construction-probe boundary: validates constructor metadata and records the add request; it does not execute native attachment.
expected: Null reference, null actor or Player actor bypass all relation mutation.
With a nonnull non-Player actor, the raw 0x400 fallback bit or true first +0x78 predicate bypasses all relation mutation.
Otherwise add the reference to the actor dropped list only if absent; insert it at the front while retaining old order.
An empty list receives its first pointer directly; a nonempty missing-reference list allocates one eight-byte node. Duplicate references allocate no node.
Set/overwrite the dropped reference dropper with the actor, regardless of its previous pointer. This helper does not inspect or clean up a previous dropper actor list.
After both mutations, query +0x78 again and request +0x40(0x20000) only when false.
Missing actor/list and reference/dropper extras request their actual original constructors and generic extra attachment before mutation.
not_established: Full 0x004DB4A0 query semantics outside the selected null-lookup fallback
Generic ExtraDataList attachment/locking and allocation-failure behavior
Previous dropper list cleanup elsewhere, pickup/removal semantics or save serialization
Production factory, normal-input break/drop and original-game runtime acceptance
